name: Daniel Madi
description: Daniel Madi is an engineer in Lebanon who builds production AI systems: voice and messaging agents, the integrations behind them, and the infrastructure they run on.
intro: I'm an engineer in Lebanon. I build AI systems that run in production: [voice and messaging agents](/projects/hala-ai/), the [integrations](/experience/#layout-intl) that connect them to business software, and the [servers and data layers](/expertise/#infrastructure) underneath.

I co-founded [Meta Empires](/experience/#meta-empires), where I lead engineering on [Hala AI](/projects/hala-ai/), a multi-tenant platform whose agents answer calls and messages across phone, WhatsApp, Instagram and the web, and book appointments or update CRM records mid-conversation. I also work as a Technical Integration Engineer at [Layout Intl](/experience/#layout-intl), on client integrations, Linux server operations and incident response.

Security runs through all of it. I'm completing a [postgraduate diploma in cybersecurity](/experience/#education) at the American University of Beirut, hold [ISC2 and Fortinet certifications](/certifications/), and write up the [security findings](/security/) I report.
